ideas.pitch: A real-time school bus tracking and safety compliance app designed specifically for local school transport fleets to prevent accidents and missing children.
ideas.title: SchoolCommute Safely
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting problem identification (15%) and high social impact (20%) which resonate strongly with school-level student juries and local administrators.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered waste segregation scanner that helps students correctly classify daily school waste into organic, recyclable, and hazardous bins using phone cameras.
ideas.title: EcoSort School Edition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high innovation scoring (25%) with clear implementation planning and a direct, measurable environmental impact on school premises.

ideas.pitch: A visual matching tool using image embeddings to automatically pair lost student items with found reports across school grounds, reducing administrative overhead.
ideas.title: CampusLost & Found AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: High feasibility (20%) and immediate operational scalability within educational institutions, matching the specific judging criteria rubric.

ideas.pitch: A lunchtime tiffin box scanner that evaluates school meal nutritional balance and gives instant feedback on missing food groups to encourage healthier eating habits.
ideas.title: NutriTiffin Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the health and impact criteria (20%) with a relatable, everyday problem faced by students and parents in school environments.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first peer tutoring schedule allocator that pairs struggling students with advanced classmates based on subjects, free periods, and skill gaps.
ideas.title: StudyBuddy Peer Match
ideas.why_it_could_win: Strong focus on scalability (10%) and practical feasibility (20%) for school deployment without requiring heavy cloud infrastructure.
